Leah: Alert from ops: unusual BYOK import flow for tenant T-773 detected at 2026-02-10T09:23:11Z. import_token used twice from two IPs within 30s. tagging for triage. @Diego @Ravi
ops-bot: alert: hsm.import.unauth_attempt tenant=T-773 count=2 first_ts=2026-02-10T09:23:11Z last_ts=2026-02-10T09:23:40Z link=https://alerts.redwood/6789
Diego: Oncall -> did we already revoke the token? If not, revoke now and rotate the token issuer cert.
Ravi: Revoke sent to token-issuer service (revoked imp-token=imp-773-20260210-01). Also triggered snapshot of HSM audit stream and pulled latest /var/log/hsm/audit.log lines via hsm-collector.
Leah: Good. What telemetry do we need to preserve for compliance? timeline, operator ids, IPs, payload hashes, KMS CMK id, and the exact import_token id. Legal will want chain-of-custody.
LegalBot: Legal: preserve immutable evidence. Add signed manifests and record who authorized revocation. Notify customer success for disclosure timeline.
Diego: We should correlate KMS CloudTrail with HSM audit. Query: cloudtrail where eventName=ImportKeyMaterial and requestParameters.cmkId=cmk-77f.
Ravi: Ran correlation query: cloudtrail shows importKeyMaterial request at 2026-02-10T09:23:11Z from ip 3.88.12.9 using role arn:aws:sts::888:assumed-role/import_session. HSM audit shows import:start and then an import:abort after token revoke.
Leah: Save exact CLI invocation for replay-proofing. If available, include the tool sha and env. Diego, can you capture the binary sha from the agent?
Diego: Got it. tooling_sha=sha256:aa11bb22cc. Also saved process args: `hsm-cli import --csr /tmp/csr.pem --token imp-773-20260210-01 --dry-run=false`.
Ravi: Forensics: we need HSM snapshot + secure copy to WORM bucket, signed evidence envelope, and an audit manifest.json with signatures. Example manifest we will write (signed):
```
{
  "incident_id": "IR-3422",
  "tenant": "T-773",
  "events": [
    {"ts":"2026-02-10T09:23:11Z","event":"import:start","actor":"assumed-role/import_session","ip":"3.88.12.9","csr_fp":"sha256:0f1e..."},
    {"ts":"2026-02-10T09:23:21Z","event":"token:revoke","actor":"token-issuer","ip":"10.0.12.4"},
    {"ts":"2026-02-10T09:23:40Z","event":"import:abort","actor":"hsm","ip":"hsm-01"}
  ],
  "hsm_snapshot_s3":"s3://redwood-worm/forensics/IR-3422/hsm-snapshot-20260210-0924.bin",
  "cloudtrail_log_s3":"s3://redwood-worm/forensics/IR-3422/cloudtrail-20260210.json",
  "signatures": ["op:Leah:sig:sha256:aaaa...","sec:Diego:sig:sha256:bbbb..."]
}
```
Diego: We'll use HSM vendor tool `hsm-collect --snapshot --out /tmp/ir-3422.bin` then `aws s3 cp --sse aws:kms /tmp/ir-3422.bin s3://redwood-worm/forensics/IR-3422/` and attach a detached signature via our signing service.
Leah: Good. Compliance asks: retention timeline and WORM policy. Priya from Legal had said 7 years for some customers. LegalBot, confirm retention and disclosure SLAs for tenant T-773.
LegalBot: Confirmed: retention 7 years in WORM; notify customer within 72 hours if key material exposure suspected. If only an attempt and aborted with no key material imported, follow disclosure guidance: notify CS + offer incident summary.
Ravi: Postmortem checklist: 1) revoke remaining tokens, 2) rotate CMK if any sign of compromise, 3) snapshot HSM, 4) export manifests to WORM, 5) create IR ticket IR-3422 and link evidence, 6) tabletop run.
Diego: Add telemetry rule: alert on import_token reuse across >1 source IP within 60s. Also add a guard: require token issuer to bind token to requester IP range or x5t of CSR.
Leah: RBAC tweak: disable long-lived import roles, require approval flow and approver MFA. Also require import_session TTL <= 5m and single-use tokens.
Ravi: I'll draft the runbook and add commands for oncall. Example revoke command for token-issuer: `curl -X POST https://token-issuer/revoke -d '{"token":"imp-773-20260210-01"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`
Diego: Also capture forensic network pcap around the time window (if retained) - file to WORM.
Leah: Next steps: Ravi -> upload artifacts + manifest to s3 and sign, Diego -> tweak telemetry rule and block offending IPs at edge, LegalBot -> confirm disclosure wording and retention, Leah -> create IR ticket and notify CS.
ops-bot: IR ticket created IR-3422 by @Leah - assigned to @Ravi, priority=P1
Leah: Thanks team. We'll discuss in the tabletop later this week.
